identity.name: Mountain's Verdict
identity.summary: A colossal stepped stone sword with a short iron grip.
identity.description: Costs 3 stamina per activation. Deals 22 physical damage per affordable activation. Warrior only: requires and spends 4 Momentum; adds 5 damage for each Momentum spent. No cost is spent if activation is unaffordable.
identity.lore: A king asked the mountain to judge him and received this answer.

effects.description: Costs 3 stamina per activation. Deals 22 physical damage per affordable activation. Warrior only: requires and spends 4 Momentum; adds 5 damage for each Momentum spent. No cost is spent if activation is unaffordable.
effects.condition: Equipped; class restriction satisfied; all activation costs can be paid together.

synergies.description: Orthogonal adjacency support and available mana/stamina determine the best arrangement. Strategic combinations grant no unlisted bonus.

conditions: All ingredients are packed, unlocked, nonpermanent and form one orthogonally connected group.
recipes.failureBehavior: Incomplete, disconnected or locked inputs consume nothing. A complete recipe always consumes its inputs; an output that cannot fit enters the stash.
recipes.description: Combine Anchor Cleaver, Gallows Halberd, Meteor Maul, Siegebell Plate, War Council Seal into Mountain's Verdict.

visual.brief: A colossal stepped stone sword with a short iron grip.
visual.paletteIntent: Restrained material ramps; deliberate spell element colors; no incidental rim light.
